entries.summary: Its reason-to-exist doesn't work in llama.cpp: there is no support for the phi4-siglip vision tower, so every GGUF is a text-only backbone (which is why our text dimensions sit unrated). An mlx-community 4-bit build exists and may be the practical local vision path on Apple Silicon via mlx-vlm — unverified by us.

mitigations.note: On a Mac, try the mlx-community 4-bit build with mlx-vlm. Elsewhere, watch llama.cpp for phi4-siglip support; until then vision needs full weights via transformers.
For local vision today, use Gemma 3, Mistral Small 4, or Qwen3.8 instead.

citations.title: Community GGUF (text-backbone-only conversion, vision tower unsupported)

entries.summary: Inherits Phi-4's 16K window — cramped for 2026, especially for the multi-image reasoning it was built for.
